name: List available analytics datasets
description: List available analytics datasets Returns the analytics dataset catalogue. GET /client/v4/analytics/sql/introspection
context:
GET /client/v4/analytics/sql/introspection
Returns the analytics dataset catalogue. By default, the response contains dataset names and descriptions. Set `include_columns` to include each dataset's column names, descriptions, and data types. The caller must have Account Analytics Read permission on the account identified by `account_tag`. Dataset names, descriptions, and columns are the same for every authorized account. When `include_custom_attributes` is set, the response also includes custom attribute names and types discovered from that account's own data, which legitimately differs per caller.
Required: account_tag (query) — Account whose available analytics datasets are returned.
Optional: include_columns (query) — Include column metadata for each returned dataset.; include_custom_attributes (query) — Include custom attribute names and types for each dataset that supports them.; dataset_name (query) — Return only the dataset with this exact name. An empty value does not filter the catalogue. An unknown name returns a successful response with an empty `datasets` array.

name: Query analytics datasets
description: Query analytics datasets Executes a SQL query against the analytics datasets available to the caller. GET /client/v4/analytics/sql
context:
GET /client/v4/analytics/sql
Executes a SQL query against the analytics datasets available to the caller. SQL placeholders can be bound with query parameters named `param_ `, such as `param_status=404` for `$status`.
Required: query (query) — SQL query to execute.

name: Query analytics datasets
description: Query analytics datasets Executes a SQL query against the analytics datasets available to the caller. POST /client/v4/analytics/sql
context:
POST /client/v4/analytics/sql
Executes a SQL query against the analytics datasets available to the caller. Send either raw SQL or a JSON object containing the query and optional positional or named parameters, time range, and account or zone scope. Raw SQL placeholders can also be bound with query parameters named `param_ `.
Required: body (body)
